research_question: Is the structural similarity evidence of internal intellectual continuity?

primary_hypothesis.statement: The observed structural overlap reflects internal continuity in the author's problem development.
primary_hypothesis.failure_effect: The continuity claim in the center conclusion must be retracted.

predictions.expected_observation: The later text explicitly reuses the earlier problem vocabulary with the same function.

rival_hypotheses.statement: Both texts draw independently on a shared resource.
rival_hypotheses.simplicity_note: Simpler when no direct authorial linkage is documented.

predictions.expected_observation: The same vocabulary appears in unrelated authors.

rival_hypotheses.statement: The similarity is a template artifact.

predictions.expected_observation: Unrelated pairs pass the same template.

falsification_conditions.statement: If all discriminating predictions fail, H1 is not supported.

operational_criteria.statement: Structural correspondence is established by shared vocabulary and function.
operational_criteria.inclusion_test: Both texts contain the same term with a comparable role.
operational_criteria.exclusion_test: Shared vocabulary without comparable role is not counted.

rival_supported.conclusion_effect: The continuity claim is retracted and only shared-resource use is reported.
